categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of electrical wires and cables, signal transmission cables and cable assemblies, and electronic components. It serves diverse industries including consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, industrial automation, medical devices, and cloud servers. The business also includes wholesale and retail of electrical and electronic materials and international trade services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes for signal transmission cables and cable assemblies, including high-frequency and high-speed data transmission technologies. It emphasizes R&D in low-loss coaxial cables, automotive Ethernet cables, industrial automation cables, and medical-grade cables. Production methods include automated quality control, EMI testing, and compliance with environmental standards such as RoHS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive (including electric vehicles), industrial control, medical equipment, and cloud data centers. The company serves major international clients in Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, with products used in devices like monitors, servers, automotive systems, and industrial cameras.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases in Taiwan and mainland China, with sales and customer service extending across Asia (China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Korea, Vietnam, India, Thailand), Europe (Germany, Poland, Norway, France, Switzerland), the Americas (Mexico, Honduras, USA), and indirect markets in Oceania and Africa. It also has subsidiaries in Thailand and Shenzhen.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing cables and cable assemblies from raw materials such as copper, PVC, and plastics sourced from upstream suppliers. It integrates vertically by investing in upstream and downstream related industries to reduce costs and enhance profitability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high value-added products for automotive, industrial automation, medical, and server applications. R&D focuses on high-frequency, low-loss cables, automotive Ethernet, 5G base station cables, and environmentally friendly materials. The company plans to invest over 3% of annual revenue in R&D to meet evolving customer design needs and expand market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cables, cable assemblies, and electronic components. The company also earns income from government subsidies and rental income from leased factory spaces. It does not engage in subscription or licensing models but focuses on manufacturing and wholesale/retail sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a well-established player with over 30 years in the cable manufacturing industry, recognized for high-quality products and strong R&D capabilities. It competes in a highly competitive market with pressure on pricing, especially in consumer electronics cables, and differentiates through product diversity, quality control, and international certifications. It maintains close cooperation with major global manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.42 billion, a 6% decline from the previous year, with a net loss of NT$178 million, improving from a larger loss the prior year. Total assets are around NT$4.3 billion, with equity of about NT$1.47 billion. The company is investing in capacity expansion and R&D to drive future growth despite recent challenges from geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological innovation, customer-centric service, and product quality as its core values. It offers a broad product portfolio tailored to diverse applications, including high-frequency and environmentally friendly cables. Its competitive edge lies in rapid prototyping, comprehensive quality assurance, and the ability to meet complex customer specifications, supported by strong R&D and global market presence.
